summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a periodic report on its share buyback program. The report covers purchases under the second tranche of a multi-year ~€3.5 billion program announced during the 2025 Capital Markets Day, expected to run through 2030. From April 10 to May 22, 2026, Ferrari purchased 277,487 shares on EXM and 34,850 on NYSE for an aggregate €81.3 million and $11.5 million, respectively. As of May 22, 2026, the company held 9.15% of common shares and 9.50% of total share capital in treasury. Share cancellation approved at the April 15, 2026 AGM has not yet been effectuated. Watch for further buyback pace and potential cancellation updates; no risk-arb angle.
